entries.zh: 正午、日午；午间时分（原件旁注疑 antemediodia，即午前，读法存疑）
entries.en: midday, noon (mediodia); before noon (antemeridian, per marginal query)
entries.notes: 西语侧注[疑:antemediodia]与汉字'日小午'互有出入，字序与读法存疑，故降中置信。

entries.zh: 量：测量、度量；量器、度量单位
entries.en: to measure; a measure, measurement (unit)

entries.zh: 管：管子、管筒（管状量具）；管理、经管
entries.en: tube, pipe (a tubular measuring vessel); to manage, take charge of

entries.zh: 推：推算、推度（估算尺寸数目）；推挤
entries.en: to reckon, infer, estimate (by calculation); to push

entries.zh: 准：准许、批准；标准、水准（量度基准）
entries.en: to allow, approve; standard, level (a gauge or norm for measuring)

entries.zh: 度：尺度、量度（名词一读）；揣度、估量、权衡（动词一读，对应 ponderar）
entries.en: measure, dimension (noun reading); to measure/estimate, to ponder, weigh (verb reading)

entries.zh: 比：比较、对比；比量（比着尺度较量尺寸）
entries.en: to compare (comparar); to size up, measure against a rule

entries.zh: 辨：辨别、分辨；此条对应'以 braza 或 vara 丈量'，与字义不合
entries.en: to distinguish, discern; (as listed) to measure by braza (fathom) or vara (yard)
entries.notes: 汉字'辨'与西语'以braza/vara丈量'义理不合，疑形近误读，存疑降中置信。

entries.zh: 以 braza（两臂展距）或 vara 量度；汉字作'掃'，旁注疑为'摻'，字义未定
entries.en: to measure with a braza (armspan/fathom) or vara; character reading uncertain
entries.notes: 原件字'掃'（义为扫）与音写及'丈量'义均不合，旁注疑'摻'，字形难定。

entries.zh: 度：尺寸、量度；一度之长；程度
entries.en: a measure, measurement; a degree or extent

entries.zh: 丈：长度单位，十尺（约合十余 palmos）；丈量
entries.en: zhang, a length unit of ten chi (over ten Spanish palmos)
entries.notes: 汉字'丈'与'十余palmos之长'义合，但音写 fung 与'丈'之闽音不合，字形或音写有误。

entries.zh: 寸：小长度单位（约当西班牙 pulgada 之一寸）；后接词组音写污损难辨
entries.en: cun, a small length unit (an inch, roughly the Spanish pulgada); trailing phrase damaged
entries.notes: 五音节音写中三处 T99 污損难辨，词组整体不可确证，故降低置信。

entries.zh: 更：夜间更次，一更约合两小时（西语：两夜时之量度）；打更报时
entries.en: geng, one of the night watches, each of two night hours; to keep night watch

entries.zh: 官：官府、官方的；此条对应'小量器'，与'官'字义不合，音写或指'管'类小量具
entries.en: official, governmental; (as listed) a small measure — fit with the character uncertain
entries.notes: '官'与'小量器'义理不合，音写 guan: cuy 依赖推断，存疑降中置信。

entries.zh: 官斗：官定斗，量器（约合十升，或对应当地量制 ganta）
entries.en: official dou, a government-standard dry measure (about ten sheng/gantas)
entries.notes: 音写后字 tau 处 T99 污損，且西语缩写[疑:cantej]（疑为菲律宾量制 ganta），'斗=十ganta'依赖推断。

entries.zh: 顷：田亩面积单位（百亩），计量播种田地
entries.en: qing, an area measure of one hundred mu, for land under cultivation (sementera)

entries.zh: 量力：衡量力量（量力而行）
entries.en: to measure/assess one's strength; to act within one's means

entries.zh: 量入而出：量入为出，衡量收入与支出
entries.en: to measure what comes in and what goes out; to live within one's means

entries.zh: 〔释义存疑〕对应'量器满而无亏（足量不缺）'，汉字音写'老頭'与此义不合
entries.en: a full measure lacking nothing (per Spanish gloss); the Chinese side does not match this sense — uncertain
entries.notes: 音写 tau 处 T99 污損，且'老頭'与'足量'义理不合，语义无法定夺。

entries.zh: 排比：并列排置、排列比对
entries.en: to arrange side by side and compare; parallel arrangement (compound measure)

entries.zh: 〔释义存疑〕对应'如地基（cimientos）般的量度'，汉字音写'陽着好'义理不合
entries.en: a measure like foundations (cimientos); the Chinese reading is unclear
entries.notes: '陽着好'与西语'如基石之量度'无法互证，语义无法定夺，故降低置信。
